blocks.text: MANILA, Philipppines — PNB Holdings Corp. grew net income 16 percent to P317.02 million in the first nine months of 2026 as the company broadened its commercial offerings to attract more customers to its buildings. On Friday, the real estate company said in a disclosure that consolidated revenues rose 5 percent to P940.35 million.
